objective: Compare independent retrospective stress, trade-flow and wallet-risk hypotheses without claiming future alpha.

lanes.name: Completed-hour stress versus price baseline
lanes.question: Do liquidation cohorts add information after price and volatility?
lanes.falsifier: No positive independent model lift or unstable month cohorts.

lanes.name: Tick/HIP4 source grain
lanes.question: Do tick-source and resolution-market event grains reconcile without identity overclaim?
lanes.hypothesis: Source joins produce consistent execution-level accounting.
lanes.baseline: Raw trade count and independent grain checks
lanes.falsifier: Timestamp drift, inconsistent liquidation notionals or unproven resolution clock.

lanes.name: Wallet forced-liquidation recurrence
lanes.question: Is repeat forced liquidation observable without assuming wallet net PnL?
lanes.hypothesis: Observed loss-event recurrence is measurable after censoring.
lanes.baseline: Distinct liquidated-wallet denominator with complete follow-up
lanes.falsifier: No valid censoring denominator or copy-trading PnL inference.
